verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents a first-party MCP integration that connects a Puzzle account directly to Claude for conversational access to live financial data without exports. Its API exposes endpoints such as balances, and its plain-English Q&A covers cash and readiness questions close to an affordability check. Missing for 10: documentation of which ledger data and tools the MCP exposes, an explicit affordability/runway-style answer flow through the agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API

citations.quote: Puzzle's MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration lets you connect your Puzzle account directly to Claude, giving you instant access to your financial data through natural conversation — no exports, no copy-pasting.
